result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You had a breast screening test (mammogram) on 16 September 2026. The clinic needs you to come back for more tests. This is called a recall.

Being called back does not mean that you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer.

At the visit you may have more mammograms. You may have an ultrasound scan. In some cases you may have a biopsy (a small sample of tissue).

You will usually get most of your results on the same day.

## What you need to do
1. Go to your appointment on 7 October 2026 at 11:00.
2. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as possible.
3. You can bring a friend or family member with you. This is your choice. You do not have to.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: your breast screening mammogram.
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: your recall appointment. It is at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital. The visit may take up to 4 hours.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen at my visit?
- Will I need a biopsy?
- When will I get all my results?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
